heading: Where the money goes.
intro: Spending over time, what's left each month, and the biggest categories.

tiles.noCompleted: No completed month in this period yet

spending.title: Spending per month
spending.subtitle: Logged expenses. The dashed line is your monthly income from the Finances page.

leftOver.title: Left over each month
leftOver.subtitle: Income minus fixed bills (from the Finances and Spending pages) minus other spending. Expenses in a bill's category only count above that bill, so nothing is subtracted twice. Red means more went out than came in. The current month is still in progress.

categories.title: Spending by category
categories.subtitle: Largest first, {range}. Smaller categories are grouped as “Other”.

forecast.title: Savings forecast
forecast.subtitle: Looking ahead from the last 3 full months, whatever period is chosen above. Your goals and what they need are on the Goals page.
